_comment: Fictional bucket comics for panel-guest nights. All bits are short original summaries, not real comedians' material.

cocky.label: Cocky
cocky.desc: Walks up like he already has a special.

nervous.label: Nervous
nervous.desc: Shaking so hard the mic stand is clicking.

weird.label: Weird
weird.desc: Brought a prop. Will not explain the prop.

polished.label: Polished
polished.desc: Tight minute. Clearly has been doing this a while.

fragile.label: Fragile
fragile.desc: Funny, but one bad word from the panel and they're done.
